lastResponse.text: You’re doing the right thing. I can connect you to a live domestic violence advocate now and pass this exactly: you need advocacy, possible shelter tonight, and a safe ride that is not from your home address, with privacy-first contact only. You can share only what feels necessary. If he appears, threatens you, or you feel in immediate danger, call nine one one right away. I can stay with you while we do the handoff.
